description: Estimate what an Indian Instagram or YouTube creator charges per deliverable, in INR, from their follower count and (optionally) average likes, comments, views and niche. Returns a price per product (Reel, Story, post, package; or YouTube integration, dedicated video, Short) when engagement figures are given, a low-high range when they are not, and the method behind it either way. Uses only the numbers you pass in: it looks nothing up. Accounts under 100 followers (subscribers on YouTube), and YouTube channels averaging under 50 views when views are given, are not priced: below that scale an engagement rate is noise, so the answer says so instead of quoting.

avg_comments.description: Average comments on recent posts or videos. Used only with avg_likes.

avg_likes.description: Average likes on recent posts or videos. Without it the answer is a range, not a price.

avg_views.description: YouTube only: average views on recent videos. Engagement on YouTube is measured against views, not subscribers, so YouTube likes are used only with this.

followers.description: Followers on Instagram, subscribers on YouTube. Under 100 is not priced.

niche.description: What the creator posts about, in a few words (e.g. "beauty", "personal finance", "tech reviews").

platform.description: Where the creator posts: instagram or youtube.

name: estimate_rate

benchmark.description: The typical rate for an account of this size, in %.

needs.description: The figure that was missing, so the engagement figures given could not be used.

ratePct.description: Average likes plus comments as a % of followers (of average views on YouTube), capped at 100. Null when it could not be worked out.

uncappedPct.description: What the figures came to before the cap. Present only when that is over 100%, which usually means a figure needs checking.

rates.description: One line per deliverable. low equals high when engagement set the price; otherwise the line is a range.

minAvgViews.description: YouTube only: the smallest average views that is priced, when views are given.

minFollowers.description: The smallest follower (subscriber) count that is priced.

error.description: What went wrong, in the words of the text answer.

retryAfterSec.description: Seconds until the limit lets another call through. Absent when the limit is a plan's searches for the day.

title: Estimate a creator's rate (INR)
